title: Tenma Tsukasa — One Foot In Front Of The Other〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: One Foot In Front Of The Other（2★）
meta.Event: The Song of a Canary in Crisis

rows.Line: Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I wasn't able to give Nene any good advice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...is about all I got.
Did I sound weird or off in any way...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I wish I could do something for her since she helped me with becoming Rio...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Nene's always had confidence in her singing, so I doubt she foresaw any of this happening...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(It seemed like quite a shock to her...
But she may be moving in the right direction since she went over to speak to the director about what he told her.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which means all we can do is believe in what she does...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Knowing that you have friends supporting you can make a huge difference. It definitely did when I was learning to play Thorpe and Rio.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But this is different from learning to play a character. She has to break some old habits, which isn't going to be easy...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I hope she figures out what she needs to do...)
A few days later
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Morning, Kusanagi!
Let's do our best again today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Nene's just putting on a face...
Saki does the same thing whenever she tells me that “everything's fine” when it really isn't...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She even has bags under her eyes...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I have a feeling that she's still stuck...
Hmm... If only there were some way we could help her...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Tenma, would you mind if we had a quick chat about the scene we'll be working on today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sakurako Seiryuin!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Of course! You might know what to do!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I see. I didn't realize you were all so worried about Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We are. We couldn't even figure out what these habits of hers are when we discussed it as a troupe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She's unaware of any such habits, which means the onus was on us to know what they are...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I understand what you're trying to say, but you may not have the experience necessary to spot these habits of hers...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What...?!
Does that mean you know what she needs to fix, Seiryuin?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes, I think so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! Then, would you mind talking to Nene for us?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: That I won't do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wha—?! Why...?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
You really have to ask?
It's the other way around. She has to come and ask me.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
I prefer not to toot my own horn...
But when it comes to singing, I'm more knowledgeable and technically skilled than Kusanagi. She's well aware of this fact.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: However, she's currently trying to solve this problem under her own power.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to demean you or Nene in any way. Please forget what I just said.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I shall.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But keep in mind that I am simply keeping my distance for now.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: When the time comes, whether or not she wishes to hear it, I am going to tell her to hard truth.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. We don't have much time left until our show opens, so we can't wait for her to find an answer on her own...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need to thank you for believing in Nene and giving her time to figure this out.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Believe in her? I simply wish to focus on practicing my own role.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Also, where does this all leave you...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes, you're doing a wonderful job of expressing your emotions... But you still have quite a few things to work on, including your character's more nuanced mannerisms, the timing for your lines and such, no...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oof...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yet your mind is preoccupied with the business of others. Do you not see a problem with that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're absolutely right, Sakurako Seiryuin.
I have no rebuttal...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As much as I want to help Nene, I need to keep working on my own character...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sakurako Seiryuin! Let's discuss that scene we'll be doing today!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
That's what I like to hear.
First, about the opening portion...
